description: This file implements the Android media service interface, including class definitions and transaction handling for media playback, recording, and related functionalities.

classes.name: BpMediaPlayerService
classes.description: Proxy class for IMediaPlayerService, facilitating IPC calls to the media service.

methods.name: createMetadataRetriever
methods.description: Creates and returns a media metadata retriever instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a media player instance with specified client, session ID, and attribution source.

methods.name: createMediaRecorder
methods.description: Creates and returns a media recorder instance with specified attribution source.

methods.name: addBatteryData
methods.description: Adds battery data parameters to the media service.

methods.name: pullBatteryData
methods.description: Retrieves battery data from the media service.

methods.name: listenForRemoteDisplay
methods.description: Sets up listening for remote display with specified package name, client, and interface.

methods.name: getCodecList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available media codecs.
